# SipHash24

SipHash-2-4 over a stream of bytes, keyed with 128 bits.

```rux
pub struct SipHash24 {
    // private fields
}
```

Copy. Holds up to seven bytes of pending input alongside its state.

## Associated functions

<h3 id="with-key"><code>WithKey</code></h3>

```rux
pub func WithKey(low: uint64, high: uint64) -> SipHash24
```

A hasher keyed with `low` and `high`, with nothing written into it yet.
Both halves are read by value. The key must be unpredictable to whoever supplies the input — draw it from
`Rux/Entropy` at startup and keep it. A fixed key compiled into a program is a published key, and a published
key is no key at all.
Cannot fail. Runs in constant time and allocates nothing.

| Name   | Type     | Description                            |
| ------ | -------- | -------------------------------------- |
| `low`  | `uint64` | the key's first eight bytes as a word  |
| `high` | `uint64` | the key's second eight bytes as a word |

**Returns**: a hasher keyed with those two words

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Hash/Src/SipHash.rux#L142)

<h3 id="with-key-bytes"><code>WithKeyBytes</code></h3>

```rux
pub func WithKeyBytes(key: *byte) -> SipHash24
```

A hasher keyed with the sixteen bytes at `key`, least significant byte of each half first.
`key` is borrowed and read. This is the byte order the specification and every published test vector use, so
it is what to reach for when checking against one; [`WithKey`](/docs/api/hash/sip-hash24#with-key) is what to reach for when the key came from
`Rux/Entropy` as two words.
Cannot fail. Runs in constant time and allocates nothing.
`key` must be readable for sixteen bytes.

| Name  | Type    | Description                                        |
| ----- | ------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `key` | `*byte` | sixteen key bytes, read as two little-endian words |

**Returns**: a hasher keyed with them

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Hash/Src/SipHash.rux#L162)

## Methods

<h3 id="reset"><code>Reset</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Reset(self: &var SipHash24)
```

Puts the hasher back to where it started, keeping its key.
`self` is borrowed mutably. Everything written so far is forgotten; the key is not.
Cannot fail. Runs in constant time and allocates nothing.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Hash/Src/SipHash.rux#L178)

## Implements Hasher

`SipHash24` conforms to [`Hasher`](/docs/api/hash/hasher).

<h3 id="write"><code>Write</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Write(
    self: &var SipHash24,
    bytes: *byte,
    length: uint
)
```

Adds `length` bytes at `bytes` to the hash.
`bytes` is borrowed and read; `length` is read by value. A zero length changes nothing and is the one case in
which `bytes` may be null. Input that does not fill an eight-byte word is held until the rest arrives, so any
division of the same byte stream into writes gives the same answer.
Runs in time proportional to `length` and allocates nothing.
`bytes` must be readable for `length` bytes.

| Name     | Type    | Description                          |
| -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------ |
| `bytes`  | `*byte` | the bytes to absorb                  |
| `length` | `uint`  | how many bytes; zero absorbs nothing |

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Hash/Src/SipHash.rux#L195)

<h3 id="finish"><code>Finish</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Finish(self: &var SipHash24) -> uint64
```

The hash of everything written so far.
`self` is borrowed. Nothing is consumed: the finishing rounds run on a copy of the state, so asking twice
gives the same answer and writing more continues from where the writes left off.
Cannot fail. Runs in constant time and allocates nothing.

**Returns**: the hash of everything written since the last reset

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Hash/Src/SipHash.rux#L240)


The four words SipHash mixes, and the round that mixes them.
Copy. Exposed because the round is the whole of the algorithm and worth being able to read, not because a caller
has any reason to drive one directly.

**Methods**

<h4 id="sip-state-round"><code>Round</code></h4>

```rux
pub func Round(self: &var SipState, count: uint)
```

Runs `count` SipHash rounds over the state.
`self` is borrowed mutably; `count` is read by value. Each round is four add-rotate-exclusive-or steps
arranged so that every word depends on every other after two of them.
Cannot fail. Runs in time proportional to `count` and allocates nothing.

| Name    | Type   | Description            |
| ------- | ------ | ---------------------- |
| `count` | `uint` | how many rounds to run |

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Hash/Src/SipHash.rux#L81)

<h3 id="sip-word"><code>SipWord</code></h3>

```rux
pub func SipWord(bytes: *byte) -> uint64
```

The eight bytes at `bytes` as a 64-bit word, least significant byte first.
`bytes` is borrowed and read. Assembled a byte at a time, so the answer is the same at any address on any
machine: SipHash is defined on a little-endian byte stream rather than on the machine's own order.
Cannot fail. Runs in constant time and allocates nothing.
`bytes` must be readable for eight bytes.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Hash/Src/SipHash.rux#L266)

**Parameters**

| Name    | Type    | Description         |
| ------- | ------- | ------------------- |
| `bytes` | `*byte` | eight bytes to read |

**Returns**: them as a little-endian word

<h3 id="sip-hash24-of"><code>SipHash24Of</code></h3>

```rux
pub func SipHash24Of(
    bytes: *byte,
    length: uint,
    low: uint64,
    high: uint64
) -> uint64
```

The SipHash-2-4 of `length` bytes at `bytes`, keyed with `low` and `high`.
`bytes` is borrowed and read; the rest are read by value. A zero length gives the hash of the empty input under
that key, and is the one case in which `bytes` may be null.
Cannot fail. Runs in time proportional to `length` and allocates nothing.
`bytes` must be readable for `length` bytes.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Hash/Src/SipHash.rux#L287)

**Parameters**

| Name     | Type     | Description                            |
| -------- | -------- | -------------------------------------- |
| `bytes`  | `*byte`  | the bytes to hash                      |
| `length` | `uint`   | how many bytes                         |
| `low`    | `uint64` | the key's first eight bytes as a word  |
| `high`   | `uint64` | the key's second eight bytes as a word |

**Returns**: their keyed hash
